H1.hypothesis: China coal and LME stocks lead aluminium by 1-3 months.
H1.coal (Australian thermal, proxy): best lead 0m, rho=+0.36; Granger(3) p=0.724, FDR q=0.827 -> NOT SUPPORTED
H1.LME stocks: NOT TESTABLE: no free historical LME stock series. The Round 2 'stocks' series was computed from the aluminium price itself.
H1.verdict: NOT SUPPORTED (coal only; stocks not testable)

H2.hypothesis: Ethylene/VCM and China export offers lead PVC by 1-2 months.
H2.monomers (US PPI basic organic chemicals: best lead 6m, rho=-0.23; Granger(3) p=0.465, FDR q=0.626 -> NOT SUPPORTED
H2.Brent crude: best lead 1m, rho=+0.41; Granger(3) p=0.000, FDR q=0.000 -> SUPPORTED
H2.China export offers: NOT TESTABLE with free data. The Round 2 'exports' series was the PVC price lagged two months.
H2.verdict: PARTIAL (monomer proxy: NOT SUPPORTED; Brent: SUPPORTED; exports not testable)

H3.hypothesis: Manufacturing activity leads both materials by 0-2 months.
H3.aluminium vs OECD China CLI: best lead 2m, rho=+0.20; Granger(3) p=0.005, FDR q=0.019 -> SUPPORTED
H3.aluminium vs US industrial production: best lead 0m, rho=+0.23; Granger(3) p=0.698, FDR q=0.827 -> PARTIAL
H3.PVC vs OECD China CLI: best lead 2m, rho=+0.18; Granger(3) p=0.001, FDR q=0.004 -> SUPPORTED
H3.PVC vs US industrial production: best lead 0m, rho=+0.26; Granger(3) p=0.416, FDR q=0.624 -> PARTIAL
H3.note: PMIs are paywalled; the OECD China CLI and US industrial production are free activity proxies.

H4.hypothesis: USD/INR moves the landed (rupee) price in the same month.
H4.does USD/INR forecast the US$ price? alu: best lead 0m, rho=-0.30; Granger(3) p=0.152, FDR q=0.365
H4.does USD/INR forecast the US$ price? PVC: best lead 1m, rho=-0.23; Granger(3) p=0.000, FDR q=0.002
H4.verdict: PARTIAL. Pass-through is one-for-one by construction (rupee price = US$ price x USD/INR), but USD/INR explains only 1% of aluminium's monthly rupee-price variance (the US$ price dominates) and 36% for the less volatile PVC index. Handle FX in the landed-cost overlay; as a predictor of the US$ price it is significant for PVC and not significant for aluminium.
